Geometry_and_Silhouette: Portable patient transport device with a rectangular canvas or fabric sheet stretched between two parallel poles.
Poles are metal tubes of roughly human height, extending beyond the fabric at both ends.
Width is narrow, roughly the width of a person's shoulders.
Functional_Components: Fabric is durable canvas or nylon in olive drab, orange, or white.
Some models have foldable legs for elevation.
Wheeled variants have a metal frame with multiple wheels and an adjustable height mechanism.
Material_and_Context: Surface shows tension lines where fabric attaches to poles.
Poles serve as handles for carrying.
Used for transporting injured or ill patients.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Upholstered convertible furniture piece functioning as both a sofa and a bed.
Length is generous, accommodating a reclining adult, with a moderate width when closed.
Armrests may be present on one or both sides.
Functional_Components: Seat cushion is thick and padded, covered in fabric or leather upholstery.
Backrest is angled for sitting comfort.
When converted, the frame unfolds to reveal a flat sleeping surface of generous width.
Material_and_Context: Legs are short wooden or metal.
Color varies widely including gray, beige, navy, and brown.
Mechanism hinges are visible along the seat edge when partially opened.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Dome-shaped Buddhist shrine with a hemispherical base rising from a square or circular platform.
Above the dome rises a square harmika topped by a tapering spire of stacked circular discs.
Overall height ranges from modest shrine size to towering monument scale.
Functional_Components: Base may have four cardinal gateways with carved decorations.
Spire creates a distinctive stepped conical silhouette.
Prayer flags may surround the structure.
Material_and_Context: Dome is typically white-washed or stone-colored, smooth and rounded.
Surface is smooth plaster or stone.
Buddhist religious monument.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Submersible warship with a streamlined cylindrical hull of extraordinary length, far exceeding that of a typical ship.
Hull is dark gray or black for underwater concealment.
Bow is rounded; stern tapers to a propeller shaft.
Functional_Components: Prominent sail (conning tower) rises from the upper deck.
Horizontal diving planes extend from the sides of the sail and stern.
Torpedo tube openings visible at the bow.
Material_and_Context: Surface shows riveted or welded steel plate construction.
Nuclear subs have a characteristic bulge in the hull for the reactor.
When surfaced, the deck is visible with various equipment and hatches.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Matching set of tailored garments consisting of a jacket and trousers made from the same fabric.
Jacket features notched or peaked lapels, two or three front buttons.
Overall silhouette is formal and fitted.
Functional_Components: Jacket has flap pockets and a vent at the back.
Trousers have a straight or tapered leg with a creased front.
Shirt and tie are typically worn underneath.
Material_and_Context: Fabric is typically wool, wool blend, or synthetic in solid colors.
Jacket shoulders are structured with padding.
Lining is visible inside the jacket.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Flat circular dial plate with hour lines radiating from a central point.
Diameter is moderate, ranging from a small garden ornament to a substantial plaza feature.
Triangular or angled gnomon rises from the center.
Functional_Components: Gnomon is aligned to the local latitude and casts a shadow to indicate time.
Dial plate has engraved or painted hour markings in Roman numerals or lines.
Mounted on a pedestal or wall.
Material_and_Context: Dial plate is typically stone, metal, or wood.
Surface is weathered for outdoor use.
Ornamental sundials feature decorative borders and Latin inscriptions.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Single convex lens, circular or oval, of moderate palm-sized diameter.
Lens is made of glass or polished crystal.
Frame is typically brass, wood, or metal with a handle or stand.
Functional_Components: Lens surface is smooth and transparent with a slight magnifying effect visible.
When held in sunlight, it focuses rays to a bright pinpoint.
Historical versions have ornate metal frames.
Material_and_Context: Used to concentrate sunlight for igniting tinder.
Modern versions are simple magnifying lenses.
Also known as a burning glass.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Eyewear with two tinted lenses mounted in a frame that rests on the nose and ears.
Each lens is moderately sized, roughly the width of an eye socket.
Bridge connects the two lenses over the nose.
Functional_Components: Temple arms extend back over the ears.
Frame styles include aviator, wayfarer, and wraparound.
Polarized lenses show a characteristic rainbow pattern when viewed at an angle.
Material_and_Context: Lenses are darkened in gray, brown, green, or mirrored to reduce glare.
Aviator style has teardrop lenses with thin metal frame.
Wayfarer style has thick plastic frame with trapezoidal lenses.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Cream or lotion product packaged in a squeezable tube or pump bottle.
Tube is of moderate hand-held size, easily gripped.
Cap is a flip-top, screw-on, or pump dispenser.
Functional_Components: Label displays SPF rating and UV protection information.
Product consistency is thick white or off-white cream.
Pump bottles have a cylindrical body with a press-down nozzle.
Material_and_Context: Tube made of flexible plastic or aluminum laminate.
Packaging features bright colors with sun imagery.
Squeeze tube has a flat crimped end.

Geometry_and_Silhouette: Bridge structure with a deck suspended from main cables that drape between two tall towers.
Towers rise prominently above the deck in an H-frame or A-frame shape.
Overall span is massive, capable of crossing wide bodies of water.
Functional_Components: Main cables are thick braided steel bundles anchored at each end.
Vertical suspender cables hang from the main cables at regular intervals.
Deck is a flat roadway spanning the full length.
Material_and_Context: Towers are constructed from steel or concrete, typically painted gray or red.
Cable pattern creates a distinctive catenary curve.
Anchored at each end of the bridge.
